authority.caller: authenticated server-side service; never arbitrary model arguments
authority.time: UTC epoch seconds supplied by trusted service clock; not client JSON
authority.database: operator-owned local SQLite WAL with FULL synchronous writes
authority.admission: BEGIN IMMEDIATE before quota, ticket or session mutation
authority.revocation: monotonic tombstone; late results never restore authority
authority.provider_output: untrusted until exact response validation and post-call state recheck

realtime.reconciliation: provider-authoritative lookup only; None remains indeterminate
realtime.duplicate_activation: forbidden across tickets, reconnects and process restarts
realtime.revoke_queue: persistent lookup and provider-session cleanup; retry idempotent revoke only

authenticated_ingress.rule: subject, session authority, pair authority, audience and scope come from the verified principal; body mismatch fails before provider mint

speech.delivery: bootstrap_for_delivery atomically consumes the issued bootstrap before returning provider material; a lost response never permits another mint for the same session
speech.duplicate_mint: forbidden for every existing session state, including issued and consumed
speech.android_pcm_ingress: right-leg G1 LC3 frames are decoded and accepted only under the captured BLE connection generation and pair identity

provider_final_response.rule: unknown or duplicate fields, partial results, stale bindings, invalid UTF-8 and oversized bodies fail closed before Flutter delivery

speech.cancellation: cancel invalidates the active session and emits no fabricated final transcript; normal stop requests finalization
speech.endpoint_policy: exact HTTPS endpoint, no URL credentials, query, fragment, redirect or non-443 port
speech.quota: atomic per-subject UTC-day reservation before provider call; includes uncertain attempts
speech.unknown_mint: does not return a ticket; session remains recovery-required and cannot be reminted
speech.new_generation: requires a new authenticated utterance session ID; an existing session binding is immutable

migration.legacy_realtime: invalidate unspent tickets; retain active state and prepare recovery identity for unresolved activation
migration.legacy_speech: no automatic import of unauthenticated or unversioned speech state; stop old processes and use a reviewed migration
migration.rollback: never restore a stale database that predates revocation or consumed bootstrap state

implementation_scope: Source-integrated authenticated speech bootstrap, durable one-shot custody, Android decoded-PCM transport, cross-platform generation fencing and final/cancel semantics. No live provider tenant, production identity deployment, encrypted metadata volume, remote revoke outbox, physical device qualification or independent acceptance is claimed.
evidence_ceiling: deterministic source, Flutter, Android and iOS tests only; not live provider tenancy, physical speech accuracy/latency/privacy, independent review or release
